heading: Marsh-Billings-Rockefeller National Historical Park Scenic Zone

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: There is established the Marsh-Billings-Rockefeller National Historical Park Scenic Zone (hereinafter in this subchapter referred to as the “scenic zone”), which shall include those lands as generally depicted on the map entitled “Marsh-Billings-Rockefeller National Historical Park Scenic Zone Map” and dated November 19, 1991.

tree.heading: Purpose
tree.text: The purpose of the scenic zone shall be to protect portions of the natural setting beyond the park boundaries that are visible from the Marsh-Billings-Rockefeller Mansion, by such means and in such a manner as will permit current and future compatible uses.

tree.heading: Acquisition of scenic easements
tree.text: Within the boundaries of the scenic zone, the Secretary is authorized only to acquire scenic easements by donation.

notes.text: Amendments1998—Pub. L. 105–277 substituted “Marsh-Billings-Rockefeller” for “Marsh-Billings” in section catchline and wherever appearing in subsecs. (a) and (b).
